places.name: Statue of Unity (Kevadia)
places.ai_summary: The world's tallest statue, dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, located near the Narmada River.

opening_hours.notes: Light and sound show in the evening.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to avoid queues.
places.address: Statue of Unity, Kevadia, Gujarat, India

attribution.title: Statue of Unity
attribution.author: Snehrashmi
attribution.description: The Statue of Unity is the world's tallest statue with a height of 182 metres (597 ft). It is a colossal statue of Indian statesman and independence activist Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel (1875–1950) who was the first Home minister of India and the chief adherent of Mahatma Gandhi during the non-violent Indian Independence movement; highly respected for his leadership in uniting the 562 princely states of India to form the single large Union of India. It is located on a river island facing the Sardar Sarovar Dam on river Narmada in Kevadiya colony, 100 kilometres (62 mi) southeast of the city of Vadodara, Gujarat, India.
